title: The Around menu ends with Somewhere else, as the mock draws it
goal: The icon animation mock ends a turn's Around menu with Somewhere else (shortcut Y), which hands you the pivot to place on the canvas, and puts a small move button beside the menu that does the same. The app has neither: its menu stops at the three named spots (and, since 2026-10-02, Custom once you have a point of your own), so the only way to a point of your own is knowing to drag the small crosshair.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/icon-animate-wt.html, #oriMenu (Its centre, Top centre, Bottom centre, menu-sep, ic-move Somewhere else… Y) and #btnPickOrigin (ghost icon button, ic-move, title Move the pivot on the canvas (Y)) beside #selOrigin. App: Sources/Photonz/MotionListInspector.swift MotionPivotSetting. Found while comparing the Around menu to the mock in task a-menu-that-says-custom-lets-you-get-back-to-cus; that task added Custom below a divider, so Somewhere else goes after it. Check Y against existing shortcuts first (Photoshop parity: no default Y in PS beyond History Brush).
acceptance: The Around menu ends with a separator and Somewhere else, with Y shown as its shortcut, below Custom when Custom is offered
Choosing it, pressing Y, or clicking the move button beside the menu lets the next click or drag on the canvas set the pivot, and Escape gives up without changing it
A walk at Next defaults chooses Somewhere else by clicking at a point, places the pivot, and reads Around as Custom with At showing the new point
Side by side with icon-animate-wt.html step 5 in the audit

log.note: Adversarial review before building: (1) the mock's Somewhere else, the move button and Y all lead to the same act: the next press on the canvas puts the pivot under the pointer and a drag carries it, one undo step. Built as a one-shot placement, like Add Click at Playhead: crosshair cursor, Escape gives up, any press places. (2) The mock ALSO has a pivot TOOL on the floating tool bar (#tPivot, Y). Task a-turning-layer-says-what-it-turns-around-and-yo cut it in its own review (a mode for one handle); this task does not bring the tool back, so the tool bar still departs from the mock: named in the audit's rough for the user to react to. (3) Y: no tool owns it (Tools.swift reserves it for future brushes; Photoshop's Y is History Brush, which this app does not have), and the mock assigns it. It goes in the menu bar too (Layer > Move the Pivot, Y) since every command lives there with its key. (4) First-timer: after choosing it there must be visible feedback the canvas is waiting: crosshair cursor over the canvas and the move button shown pressed. No chrome sentence. (5) A press anywhere on the canvas places, even off the layer, since a pivot can sit outside the drawing (a pendulum's mount).

Built and verified. Around menu ends with a divider + Somewhere else… (move glyph, Y printed), below Custom. Move button beside the menu (accent, held in while waiting; second click lets go). Layer > Move the Pivot (Y) in the menu bar. Next press on the canvas puts the pivot down under the pointer and a drag carries it (one undo step); Escape gives up via an app-wide key monitor (left to the canvas if a pivot is already under the hand); picking another layer or tool ends it. Walks green at Next defaults: pivot-somewhere-else-walk (lock-safe: menu choose, click at a point, button pressed with real mouse events, Escape, Y via shortcut stand-in, drag, undo) and pivot-somewhere-else-menu-walk (pointer click on the menu's face, picture of it open). motion-pivot*, custom-goes-back walks still green. Scripts/test.sh: 11001 tests passed. Mock side by side in the audit. Rough items left in the audit, not filed: the mock's tool bar pivot tool (an earlier task's deliberate cut, now an evaluate question for the user) and the bordered Around box reading numbers (an earlier decision). Neither is new or broken, so neither cleared the bar.

Around menu ends with Somewhere else (Y) below Custom, a move button beside it, and Layer > Move the Pivot (Y): the next canvas press places the pivot, a drag carries it, Escape gives up. Verified by pivot-somewhere-else-walk and pivot-somewhere-else-menu-walk at Next defaults, 11001 tests green, audit queue/audits/2026-10-02-pivot-somewhere-else.json with the mock side by side.
